thread:
zoe: dropping a new exploration for the request drilldown header. goal: make permalink and export less noisy but still obvious. demo: https://img.redwood.dev/drilldown-header-v2.png
mike: looks promising. i like the compact ID + copy action on the left. question: should "Export" remain a top-level button or move into the kebab menu?
zoe: leaning kebab. export is powerful but heavy (backend job). keep "Copy permalink" visible and Surface "Save snapshot" behind kebab.
tara: accessibility point 1: if export is in a menu, the menu MUST be keyboard operable and expose aria-haspopup/aria-expanded. also ensure the menu items are focusable and announced correctly.
mike: agreed. also propose we add a secondary small action: "Copy stack frame" when a frame is focused. it's common for devs to paste a frame into bug reports.\o
infra: on the implement side, copying full stack frames is cheap. exporting full trace can take seconds for long traces. showing a spinner or toast after export request helps set expectations.
tara: microcopy note: change "Share" -> "Copy trace permalink"; "Share" was interpreted as sharing to external apps. explicitness reduces confusion and aids translation.
zoe: good call. i'll update the mocks. also thinking of truncating the correlation id in UI e.g. `req_1a2b...9f` and reveal full on hover/focus, with a dedicated copy button visible.
mike: truncation + hover tooltip is fine. ensure tooltip content is accessible (aria-describedby) rather than relying only on mouse hover.
tara: focus ring: our previous audit flagged the thin 1px ring as insufficient. propose 3px high-contrast ring for keyboard focus on toolbar actions. also ensure focus highlight is not removed via -webkit-focus-ring-color hacks.\o
zoe: agreed. i'll supply a spec: focus thickness, color tokens, and fallback for high contrast mode.
infra: small implementation note: for clipboard copy we should use navigator.clipboard with fallback to `document.execCommand('copy')`. attach ephemeral aria-live region to announce "Copied permalink". do NOT set aria-live on the button itself.
tara: exactly, use an offscreen announcer div (sr-only) and update its text so screen readers announce status once copy completes. avoid polite/assertive confusion; polite is fine here.
mike: UI suggestion: add a subtle inline indicator after copy like "copied" that fades after 2s. helps sighted users. keep this separate from screen reader announcements.
o
zoe: another UX thought: move export file type options into a nested submenu: Export -> Trace (JSON) / HAR / Events CSV. keep default as JSON. that prevents accidental large HAR downloads.
ara: (typo) tara: nested menus are fine but watch mobile behavior. kebab should expand into bottom sheet on small widths.
infra: we'll implement responsive menu as bottom sheet for < 600px. export job will return a signed URL for download; show a progress state and email notification if file exceeds X MB.
zoe: nit on copy icon: instead of generic clipboard icon, let's use an icon with a tiny label like "Copy ID" on hover to aid discovery. also prefer text button when space allows on wide screens.
mike: can we add a small affordance for "View raw stack" vs collapsed stackframes? many folks want quick pasteable text. maybe a small chevron toggle in the stack header.
tara: that toggle needs aria-expanded state and proper announcement when the stack is expanded/collapsed. also ensure the collapsed state maintains semantic headings for screen reader users.
o
zoe: i'll push updated proto with: prominent copy permalink, export in kebab -> nested types, copy frame action, improved focus rings, and responsive kebab behavior.
mike: i'll review CSS vars for focus ring and icon spacing.
tara: i'll write an a11y checklist: keyboard flow, aria labels, live region, tooltip accessibility, contrast ratios, screen reader validation steps.
accessibility-bot: Reminder: please run axe/core checks and include VoiceOver walkthrough in the PR checklist.
zoe: thanks folks 74. adding tickets: #trace-header-copy, #trace-export-menu, #stackframe-copy. will post prototypes before EOD.
